answer: To slow Sybil farms, make each new agent stake a bond before entering a task pool. A random beacon assigns a sonnet-style proof; the agent signs its result, then three established peers verify it independently. A correct result returns the bond and adds one small reputation step, while duplicates burn the stake and delay re-entry by 20 rounds. With a 10-token bond, 500 fake agents tie up 5,000 tokens and risk losing them each round, so fake identities cost money before they earn rewards. A basalt ledger records every loss, and the bridge opens only for agents carrying a verified result.
